about:
Based in Nashville, Tennessee, Sattler Manufacturing operates as a custom metal fabrication shop serving the Middle Tennessee region. The company combines decades of industrial fabrication experience with modern metal shop technologies, including laser cutting, to produce custom parts, equipment, and structures.

The shop works with stainless steel, aluminum, and mild steel, offering processes such as laser cutting, shearing, bending, welding, and forming. In addition to fabrication, Sattler provides in-house design and engineering support, including CAD drawing conversion, 3D solid modeling, value engineering, and project management. The team also handles industrial maintenance, pipefitting, and on-site installation of replacement equipment.

Industrial engineering, operations, plant maintenance, and safety managers throughout Middle Tennessee rely on Sattler for projects ranging from material handling systems and piping to structural frames, food processing equipment, and machine guarding. The company's customer base includes manufacturers, machinists, and engineers who need prototype runs as well as production quantities.

Sattler emphasizes its blend of long-standing fabrication expertise with current laser technology to deliver fast, affordable custom metalwork. The firm states that its engineers and fabricators work hand-in-hand with clients to ensure every project meets specifications, budget, and schedule.
